JMSuspendAWTContext

Stops the thread group associated with an AWT context.
OSStatus JMSuspendAWTContext (JMAWTContextRef context);
context
The AWT context whose thread you want to suspend.
function result
A result code. See "JManager Result Codes" (page 69) for a list of result codes that JManager may return in this field.
DISCUSSION
To resume a suspended thread, you must call JMResumeAWTContext. Disposing of an AWT context (using JMDisposeAWTContext) automatically stops the associated threads.

SEE ALSO
The JMResumeAWTContext function (page 30).
